title: gymnadenia rubra f. hygrophila
intro: Gymnadenia rubra f. hygrophila, commonly known as the bog orchid, is a type of orchid species native to various regions in the world. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia rubra f. hygrophila include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help in soothing and healing wounds. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
